findings.issue: RESOLVED - prior INFO fr-wavea-i3. The amendment differentiates the closing answer's toolbar from the non-closing response's toolbar, which is exactly what the `label` sidecar demands ("Must differ from the closing answer's 'Answer actions' toolbar, so a turn with several responses does not announce several identical toolbars"). « finale » is an addition to the English word, and it is accurate rather than invented: message-actions-row.tsx mounts this label on the answer kind, which is the turn-closing row, while kind === "response" takes ui.chat.response_actions.label. All four toolbars a single turn can mount now announce distinct names: « Actions de votre message », « Actions du commentaire », « Actions de la réponse », « Actions de la réponse finale ». Alternatives weighed: « Actions de la réponse de clôture » (unambiguous but heavy on a screen-reader-only name) and « Actions du message final » (wrong noun - the row is an answer, and the other three names all say réponse).
